title: Signal and Track Switch Repairers
description: Install, inspect, test, maintain, or repair electric gate crossings, signals, signal equipment, track switches, section lines, or intercommunications systems within a railroad system.

tasks.text: Inspect and test operation, mechanical parts, and circuitry of gate crossings, signals, and signal equipment such as interlocks and hotbox detectors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to locate or identify electrical problems.
Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Inspect electrical units of railroad grade crossing gates and repair loose bolts and defective electrical connections and parts.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating electrical faults requires hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to locate or identify electrical problems.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Drive motor vehicles to job sites.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles at work sites is situated mobility

dwas.name: Drive trucks or other vehicles to or at work sites.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Install, inspect, maintain, and repair various railroad service equipment on the road or in the shop, including railroad signal systems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.text: Tighten loose bolts, using wrenches, and test circuits and connections by opening and closing gates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.
Adjust the tension of nuts or bolts.

tasks.text: Inspect switch-controlling mechanisms on trolley wires and in track beds, using hand tools and test equipment.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.text: Replace defective wiring, broken lenses, or burned-out light bulbs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Inspect, maintain, and replace batteries as needed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Defect detection in electrical systems needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect electrical or electronic systems for defects.

tasks.text: Record and report information about mileage or track inspected, repairs performed, and equipment requiring replacement.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Record parts and repair details from provided data

dwas.name: Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures.

tasks.text: Lubricate moving parts on gate-crossing mechanisms and swinging signals.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Clean lenses of lamps with cloths and solvents.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
